entries.name: Valid-context feature transport
entries.name_zh: 有效上下文特征传递
entries.explanation: Moves pooled valid-region feature information into missing regions through learned residuals.

entries.name: Frozen-backbone context adapter
entries.name_zh: 冻结主干的上下文适配器
entries.explanation: Trains the context adapter while retaining the initial foundation backbone.

entries.name: Fire-weighted feature distillation
entries.name_zh: 火点加权特征蒸馏
entries.explanation: Matches student features to a frozen clean-input teacher with spatial and fire-target weighting.

entries.name: Latent fire-transition head
entries.name_zh: 潜在火情转移预测头
entries.explanation: Combines occupancy, continuation, and new-activity predictions into a next-day forecast.

entries.name: Spatial-risk loss weighting
entries.name_zh: 空间风险损失加权
entries.explanation: Reweights the forecasting objective spatially under controlled missingness.

entries.name: Missing-region consistency
entries.name_zh: 缺失区域一致性
entries.explanation: Localizes predictive consistency instead of applying the global consistency objective.

entries.name: Balanced corruption sampling
entries.name_zh: 均衡缺失采样
entries.explanation: Changes training corruption coverage through balanced corruption sampling.

entries.name: Missingness-conditioned residual experts
entries.name_zh: 缺失条件残差专家
entries.explanation: Proposes residual experts conditioned on the observed missingness pattern.

entries.name: Impact-weighted predictive consistency
entries.name_zh: 影响加权预测一致性
entries.explanation: Weights clean-to-corrupted prediction consistency by counterfactual corruption impact.

entries.name: Spatial-impact feature modulation
entries.name_zh: 空间影响特征调制
entries.explanation: Uses spatial context to modulate decoder features with a FiLM mechanism.

entries.name: Forecast-trained dynamic inpainting
entries.name_zh: 预测损失训练的动态输入修补
entries.explanation: Restores missing dynamic inputs using the forecasting objective.

entries.name: Reconstruction-supervised dynamic inpainting
entries.name_zh: 重建监督的动态输入修补
entries.explanation: Adds reconstruction supervision to the forecast-trained restoration mechanism.

entries.name: Counterfactual FireDrop specialist
entries.name_zh: 反事实火点历史缺失专家
entries.explanation: Specializes continuation training for complete fire-history removal using counterfactual consistency.

entries.name: Normalized diffusion inpainting
entries.name_zh: 归一化扩散修补
entries.explanation: Propagates observed spatial values into missing regions without learned restoration parameters.

entries.name: Mixed-severity block specialist
entries.name_zh: 混合缺失程度块状缺失专家
entries.explanation: Trains one block-only specialist with both 25% and 50% missing-block severities.

entries.name: Distance-to-observation prompts
entries.name_zh: 观测距离提示
entries.explanation: Injects encoder prompts scaled by depth inside a missing spatial region.

entries.name: Block-trained dynamic inpainting
entries.name_zh: 块状缺失训练的动态输入修补
entries.explanation: Trains the dynamic restoration module under the block-only specialist schedule.

entries.name: Fixed-severity block specialists
entries.name_zh: 固定缺失程度块状缺失专家组
entries.explanation: Trains separate 25% and 50% block-only specialists and selects them by observed missing fraction.

entries.name: Block-trained context transport
entries.name_zh: 块状缺失训练的上下文传递
entries.explanation: Adds valid-context transport to the block-specialist training recipe.

entries.name: Severity-conditioned latent adapters
entries.name_zh: 缺失程度条件潜在特征适配器
entries.explanation: Conditions latent feature adapters on block-missingness severity.

entries.name: ERM-anchored impact consistency
entries.name_zh: 经验风险最小化锚定的影响一致性
entries.explanation: Anchors the impact-consistency recipe to the matched ERM continuation objective.

entries.name: First-layer reliability calibration
entries.name_zh: 首层可靠性校准
entries.explanation: Proposes reliability-dependent calibration at the first model layer.

entries.name: Cosine-schedule continuation
entries.name_zh: 余弦学习率续训
entries.explanation: Continues ERM training with cosine learning-rate decay instead of the matched constant-rate schedule.

entries.name: Impact-consistent block specialist
entries.name_zh: 影响一致性块状缺失专家
entries.explanation: Adds impact-weighted consistency to the block-specialist recipe.

entries.name: Frozen-clean FireDrop distillation
entries.name_zh: 冻结完整输入教师的火点缺失蒸馏
entries.explanation: Proposes a frozen clean-input teacher for FireDrop-specialist distillation.

entries.name: Block-specialist reliability prompts
entries.name_zh: 块状缺失专家可靠性提示
entries.explanation: Adds severity-adaptive reliability prompts to block-specialist training.

entries.name: Cosine-scheduled impact consistency
entries.name_zh: 余弦学习率影响一致性
entries.explanation: Combines cosine-scheduled continuation with impact-weighted FireDrop consistency.

entries.name: Forecast-guided block selection
entries.name_zh: 预测引导的缺失块选择
entries.explanation: Selects hard missing blocks using forecast information during specialist training.

entries.name: VIIRS-footprint missingness augmentation
entries.name_zh: VIIRS观测足迹缺失增强
entries.explanation: Uses VIIRS reliability-footprint geometry for training corruption instead of rectangular blocks.

entries.name: Valid-context memory attention
entries.name_zh: 有效上下文记忆注意力
entries.explanation: Retrieves valid-context information through attention during block-specialist training.

entries.name: Training-only fire-change heads
entries.name_zh: 仅训练使用的火情变化预测头
entries.explanation: Adds auxiliary fire-change prediction heads during training.

entries.name: Multiscale forecast supervision
entries.name_zh: 多尺度预测监督
entries.explanation: Adds forecasting supervision at multiple feature scales.

entries.name: Context-and-transition composition
entries.name_zh: 上下文与火情转移组合
entries.explanation: Combines context transport with the latent fire-transition head.

entries.name: Original feature-distillation block analysis
entries.name_zh: 原始特征蒸馏块状缺失分析
entries.explanation: Records the original feature-distillation variant's block results; it is not a separate new mechanism.

entries.name: Decoupled fire-transition head
entries.name_zh: 解耦火情转移预测头
entries.explanation: Changes the coupling in the latent-transition prediction mechanism.

entries.name: Fivefold spatial-risk weighting
entries.name_zh: 五倍空间风险加权
entries.explanation: Increases the spatial-risk weighting strength in a repair variant.

entries.name: Block-local feature distillation
entries.name_zh: 块内局部特征蒸馏
entries.explanation: Restricts feature distillation to the block-local repair variant.

entries.name: Impact-and-block specialist route
entries.name_zh: 影响一致性与块状缺失专家路由
entries.explanation: Routes fire-history loss to impact consistency and spatial loss to fixed-severity block specialists.

entries.name: Condition-specific specialist route
entries.name_zh: 按缺失条件选择的专家路由
entries.explanation: Combines cosine continuation for FireDrop with fixed-severity block specialists; the historical and current clean-input routes differ.

entries.name: Legacy 3000-step foundation comparison
entries.name_zh: 历史3000步基础模型比较
entries.explanation: Records the legacy C00/C02 foundation runs with an invalid pooled-year resolver.

entries.name: Legacy six-run 10000-step foundation comparison
entries.name_zh: 历史六次10000步基础模型比较
entries.explanation: Records the six legacy C00/C02 runs with invalid training exposure.

entries.name: Legacy FireDrop training
entries.name_zh: 历史火点缺失训练
entries.explanation: Trains with complete fire-history removal in the legacy experiment family.

entries.name: Legacy FireDrop-and-BlockDrop training
entries.name_zh: 历史火点与块状缺失训练
entries.explanation: Adds spatial block corruption to the legacy FireDrop recipe.

entries.name: Legacy group-robust optimization
entries.name_zh: 历史分组鲁棒优化
entries.explanation: Uses GroupDRO in the legacy continuation comparison.

entries.name: Legacy matched ERM continuation
entries.name_zh: 历史匹配经验风险最小化续训
entries.explanation: Provides the matched ERM continuation control for legacy GroupDRO.

entries.name: Legacy validity-channel input
entries.name_zh: 历史有效性通道输入
entries.explanation: Adds an input validity channel in the legacy model family.

entries.name: Legacy hard expert router
entries.name_zh: 历史硬选择专家路由
entries.explanation: Uses hard routing in the legacy specialist comparison.

entries.name: Legacy pointwise residual correction
entries.name_zh: 历史逐点残差修正
entries.explanation: Adds a 1-by-1 residual correction to the legacy predictor.

entries.name: Legacy spatial residual correction
entries.name_zh: 历史空间残差修正
entries.explanation: Adds a 3-by-3 residual correction to the legacy predictor.

entries.name: Legacy decoder adaptation
entries.name_zh: 历史解码器适配
entries.explanation: Adapts the decoder in the legacy correction family.

entries.name: Legacy stochastic residual correction
entries.name_zh: 历史随机残差修正
entries.explanation: Uses a stochastic residual correction in the legacy predictor.

entries.name: Legacy teacher-posterior correction
entries.name_zh: 历史教师后验修正
entries.explanation: Uses teacher-posterior information in the legacy correction family.

entries.name: Legacy missingness-pattern router
entries.name_zh: 历史缺失模式路由
entries.explanation: Routes predictions according to missingness in the legacy FireDrop comparison.

entries.name: Prevalence-weighted focal loss
entries.name_zh: 按发生率加权的焦点损失
entries.explanation: Sets focal-loss alpha from prevalence in the legacy probe.

entries.name: Legacy FireDrop specialist
entries.name_zh: 历史火点缺失专家
entries.explanation: Evaluates a dedicated FireDrop expert in the legacy family.

entries.name: T1 belief-state filter
entries.name_zh: 单日历史信念状态滤波
entries.explanation: Uses belief-state filtering in the T1 legacy probe.

entries.name: T1 belief-state attention
entries.name_zh: 单日历史信念状态注意力
entries.explanation: Uses attention over belief-state information in the T1 legacy probe.

entries.name: T1 belief-state reconstruction
entries.name_zh: 单日历史信念状态重建
entries.explanation: Uses belief-state reconstruction in the T1 legacy probe.

entries.name: T5 belief-state probe suite
entries.name_zh: 五日历史信念状态实验组
entries.explanation: Groups the corresponding T5 belief-state probes; it is a suite rather than one mechanism.

entries.name: Natural VIIRS observation screen
entries.name_zh: 自然VIIRS观测筛查
entries.explanation: Screens prediction behavior on naturally varying VIIRS observations.

entries.name: Target-observation quality censoring
entries.name_zh: 目标观测质量筛除
entries.explanation: Examines evaluation after censoring targets without reliable target-day observations.

entries.name: Multiyear observation-quality cohort preparation
entries.name_zh: 多年观测质量队列准备
entries.explanation: Attempts to prepare the 2016–2020 observation-quality cohort; this is a data-preparation record.

entries.name: Equal-year training sampler
entries.name_zh: 等年份训练采样
entries.explanation: Samples training years equally in a corrected-baseline comparison.

entries.name: Reliability-normalized convolution
entries.name_zh: 可靠性归一化卷积
entries.explanation: Changes convolution normalization according to reliability information.

entries.name: Temporal reliability fusion
entries.name_zh: 时序可靠性融合
entries.explanation: Proposes temporal fusion using reliability information.

entries.name: Input reliability token
entries.name_zh: 输入可靠性令牌
entries.explanation: Adds a reliability token at the model input.

entries.name: T1 counterfactual-impact consistency
entries.name_zh: 单日历史反事实影响一致性
entries.explanation: Applies counterfactual-impact-weighted consistency in the corrected T1 campaign.

entries.name: T1 impact-and-rank consistency
entries.name_zh: 单日历史影响与排序一致性
entries.explanation: Adds rank consistency to the corrected T1 impact-consistency recipe.

entries.name: Counterfactual reliability adapter
entries.name_zh: 反事实可靠性适配器
entries.explanation: Adds a reliability adapter in the corrected T1 campaign.

entries.name: Factorized reliability adapter
entries.name_zh: 因子化可靠性适配器
entries.explanation: Uses a factorized variant of the reliability adapter.

entries.name: Error-pair ranking objective
entries.name_zh: 误差对排序目标
entries.explanation: Adds an error-pair ranking objective to the corrected T1 comparison.

entries.name: Reliability prompt pyramid
entries.name_zh: 可靠性提示金字塔
entries.explanation: Injects reliability prompts across multiple model scales.

entries.name: Complete-variant reliability prompt pyramid
entries.name_zh: 完整变体可靠性提示金字塔
entries.explanation: Uses the archived complete-prompt-pyramid variant, distinct from the D10 recipe.

entries.name: T5 severity-adaptive reliability prompts
entries.name_zh: 五日历史缺失程度自适应可靠性提示
entries.explanation: Transfers severity-adaptive reliability prompting to the corrected T5 foundation.

entries.name: Corrected T1 clean-input baseline
entries.name_zh: 修正单日历史完整输入基线
entries.explanation: Trains the corrected project T1 baseline on clean inputs under the project contract.

entries.name: Corrected T1 FireDrop-trained baseline
entries.name_zh: 修正单日历史火点缺失训练基线
entries.explanation: Uses stochastic FireDrop during corrected T1 baseline training; its reported specialist contribution selects B2 for FireDrop and B0 elsewhere.

entries.name: T1 missingness-trained foundation
entries.name_zh: 单日历史缺失训练基础模型
entries.explanation: Adds BlockDrop to corrected T1 FireDrop training and supplies the T1 continuation foundation.

entries.name: T1 global predictive consistency
entries.name_zh: 单日历史全局预测一致性
entries.explanation: Adds global prediction consistency in the corrected T1 campaign against D1-ERM.

entries.name: Standard reliability control
entries.name_zh: 标准可靠性对照
entries.explanation: Provides the matched standard-reliability recipe for module attribution.

entries.name: T1 severity-adaptive reliability prompts
entries.name_zh: 单日历史缺失程度自适应可靠性提示
entries.explanation: Adds severity-adaptive reliability prompts to the corrected T1 standard-reliability recipe.

entries.name: Batch-stat missingness normalization
entries.name_zh: 批次统计缺失条件归一化
entries.explanation: Calibrates missingness-conditional batch normalization using the corrected batch-stat diagnostic.

entries.name: Fixed-forward missingness normalization
entries.name_zh: 固定前向缺失条件归一化
entries.explanation: Records the original fixed-forward conditional-normalization diagnostic, later superseded.

entries.name: Mixed-input shallow residual branch
entries.name_zh: 混合输入浅层残差分支
entries.explanation: Processes static and dynamic inputs jointly in an equal-capacity shallow residual branch.

entries.name: Separate static-and-dynamic residual branches
entries.name_zh: 静态动态分离残差分支
entries.explanation: Separates static and dynamic shallow processing against the equal-capacity mixed-input control.

entries.name: Reliability-fusion same-input expert distillation
entries.name_zh: 可靠性融合实验同输入专家蒸馏
entries.explanation: Distills a routed teacher using the same corrupted input for teacher and student in the reliability-fusion campaign.

entries.name: Legacy four-bank normalization
entries.name_zh: 历史四组统计归一化
entries.explanation: Separates batch-normalization statistics into four condition banks in the earlier three-directions campaign.

entries.name: Half-and-half expert weight merge
entries.name_zh: 专家权重等比例合并
entries.explanation: Averages generalist and block-specialist model weights with a fixed 0.5 coefficient.

entries.name: Legacy routed-expert distillation
entries.name_zh: 历史路由专家蒸馏
entries.explanation: Distills the expert route into one student in the earlier three-directions campaign.

entries.name: SegFormer-B2 recipe transfer
entries.name_zh: SegFormer-B2训练方案迁移
entries.explanation: Tests continuation and specialist recipes with the SegFormer-B2 architecture.

entries.name: Swin-Unet recipe transfer
entries.name_zh: Swin-Unet训练方案迁移
entries.explanation: Tests continuation and specialist recipes with the Swin-Unet architecture.

entries.name: ConvLSTM recipe transfer
entries.name_zh: ConvLSTM训练方案迁移
entries.explanation: Records the architecture-transfer campaign for ConvLSTM without implying completed screen results.

entries.name: Legacy residual-correction block comparison
entries.name_zh: 历史残差修正块状缺失比较
entries.explanation: Groups legacy residual variants compared with P00 on block-missingness scenarios.

entries.name: Cross-history global predictive consistency
entries.name_zh: 跨历史设置全局预测一致性
entries.explanation: Provides global predictive consistency as the cross-history control for localized or impact-weighted variants.

entries.name: Impact-and-inpainting route
entries.name_zh: 影响一致性与输入修补路由
entries.explanation: Combines impact consistency for FireDrop with dynamic inpainting for spatial missingness.

entries.name: Reconstruction-inpainting total-effect comparison
entries.name_zh: 重建修补总体效果比较
entries.explanation: Compares reconstruction-supervised restoration with fresh ERM to measure the full recipe rather than isolate reconstruction.

entries.name: Corrected T5 clean-input baseline
entries.name_zh: 修正五日历史完整输入基线
entries.explanation: Provides the corrected clean T5 reference; architecture and features also differ from T1.

entries.name: T5 missingness-trained foundation
entries.name_zh: 五日历史缺失训练基础模型
entries.explanation: Uses corrected T5 FireDrop-and-BlockDrop training as the T5 continuation foundation.

entries.name: Legacy group-robust total-effect comparison
entries.name_zh: 历史分组鲁棒总体效果比较
entries.explanation: Compares GroupDRO plus continuation with P00 without isolating the GroupDRO contribution.

entries.name: No-fire and persistence references
entries.name_zh: 无火与持续性参考
entries.explanation: Groups deterministic no-fire and persistence references rather than a learned method.

entries.name: Official WSTS reproduction reference
entries.name_zh: 官方WSTS复现参考
entries.explanation: Records the official Res18 U-Net reproduction and released-weight reference under the original WSTS contract.

entries.name: Matched ERM continuation
entries.name_zh: 匹配经验风险最小化续训
entries.explanation: Continues from the matching B3 or B5 foundation with the fixed constant-learning-rate ERM recipe. Fresh means a newly run continuation, not training from random initialization.

entries.name: Corrected T1 consistency control
entries.name_zh: 修正单日历史一致性对照
entries.explanation: Provides the corrected T1 ERM comparator for D1-KL; this historical control is distinct from the later cross-history fresh continuation.

entries.name: Official WSTS Fold 2 reproduction
entries.name_zh: 官方WSTS第二折复现
entries.explanation: Uses the official Fold 2 data, split, and training contract; its score cannot isolate a method gain over corrected project B0.

entries.name: Complete-input scenario
entries.name_zh: 完整输入场景
entries.explanation: Evaluates inputs without the controlled missingness intervention.

entries.name: Fire-history-missing scenario
entries.name_zh: 火点历史完全缺失场景
entries.explanation: Removes active-fire history from the input; this is an evaluation condition, not an algorithm.

entries.name: Quarter-block-missing scenario
entries.name_zh: 四分之一块状缺失场景
entries.explanation: Applies structured missing blocks over 25% of the dynamic input.

entries.name: Half-block-missing scenario
entries.name_zh: 二分之一块状缺失场景
entries.explanation: Applies structured missing blocks over 50% of the dynamic input.
